# BeingEcom

> Ecommerce growth system for Shopify and WooCommerce brands. Paid ads, CRO, SEO, email/SMS automation, creative production and analytics - delivered by a senior, ecommerce-only operator team that acts as your fractional CMO, CRO and Head of Performance.

BeingEcom is not a generalist agency. Every engagement is ecommerce-only and revenue-accountable: weekly execution on ads, conversion rate optimization, SEO, retention and creative, with transparent reporting tied to ROAS, contribution margin and LTV. The site explains the operating system, the nine services, real client case studies, six pillar knowledge hubs, an ecommerce glossary, and a free 60-second AI store audit.

## Company

- [Home](/): Overview of the BeingEcom ecommerce growth system, headline outcomes, the 4-stage operating model and primary CTAs.
- [About](/about): Team, mission, vision, operating principles and why BeingEcom is operator-led instead of agency-led.
- [Founder — Tahir Abbas](/company/founder): Founder & CEO — background, timeline, publications and industry positioning.
- [Team](/company/team): Leadership (Tahir Abbas — CEO, Ali Abbas — CTO, Hasnain Abbas — MD) and how pods are structured.
- [Methodology](/company/methodology): The BeingEcom operating system — diagnosis, stabilisation, 90-day plan, weekly rhythm, quarterly step-change.
- [Why Us](/company/why-us): The senior-only, ecommerce-only positioning and how it differs from generalist agencies.

## Knowledge Hub (pillar guides)

- [Knowledge Hub Index](/hub): Six pillar hubs covering the full ecommerce growth stack.
- [Shopify Growth Hub](/hub/shopify-growth): SEO, speed, CRO, paid, email, headless Hydrogen and scaling for Shopify and Shopify Plus.
- [WooCommerce Growth Hub](/hub/woocommerce-growth): Speed, plugin discipline, checkout, hosting and scaling Woo past £100k/month.
- [Ecommerce SEO Hub](/hub/ecommerce-seo): Technical, on-page, off-page, local, international and Answer Engine Optimisation.
- [Paid Media Hub](/hub/paid-media): Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube — profitable buying against contribution margin and MER.
- [CRO Hub](/hub/cro): Research → hypothesis → sample-sized experimentation on PDP, cart, checkout and PLP.
- [AI Automation Hub](/hub/ai-automation): Reporting, creative testing, keyword research and support automation for senior ecommerce teams.
